note: Submodule of domain_entity. Adds a domain_access entity_reference field to menu_link_content (shipped in config/install). Per-menu opt-in is stored as third_party_settings.domain_menu_access.access_enabled = true on the system.menu.<id> config entity, set from the settings form at /admin/config/domain/menu/access/settings (permission 'administer domains'). Enabled menus get their block swapped to DomainMenuAccessMenuBlock and links filtered by DomainMenuLinkTreeManipulators::checkDomain(). Medium introspection enables control on the 'main' menu and the agent reports which menus are enabled; hard execution enables control on the 'footer' menu, verified by the menu's third-party setting. Fixtures only toggle a third-party setting on existing core menus and unset it afterwards.

evals.prompt: With the domain_menu_access module, how do you turn on per-domain control for a particular menu, and what is stored on the menu to record that?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/domain/menu/access/settings (route domain_menu_access.settings, permission 'administer domains') you tick the menu. That saves third_party_settings.domain_menu_access.access_enabled = true on the menu's system.menu.<id> config entity.

evals.prompt: What field does domain_menu_access add to menu links, and what happens to a menu link that has no domain assigned?
evals.expected_output: It installs a 'domain_access' entity_reference field (target domain, unlimited cardinality) on menu_link_content. A link with an empty domain_access value is treated as available on all domains; otherwise it only shows on the referenced domain(s).

evals.prompt: On a domain-enabled menu, how does domain_menu_access actually stop links from the wrong domain being shown?
evals.expected_output: hook_block_alter swaps the menu's system_menu_block for DomainMenuAccessMenuBlock, whose DomainMenuLinkTreeManipulators::checkDomain() forbids any link whose domain_access does not include the active domain (turning it into an InaccessibleMenuLink). Access varies by the url.site cache context.

evals.prompt: On this site, per-domain menu control (domain_menu_access) has been switched on for exactly one menu. Inspect the live configuration and name the menu that has domain menu access enabled.
evals.expected_output: The 'main' menu has access_enabled: in system.menu.main the third_party_settings.domain_menu_access.access_enabled is true (Menu::load('main')->getThirdPartySetting('domain_menu_access','access_enabled')).

evals.prompt: Using domain_menu_access, enable per-domain access control on the 'Footer' menu (machine name footer) on this site, so its links can be scoped per domain. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: system.menu.footer now has third_party_settings.domain_menu_access.access_enabled = true (via the settings form, or Menu::load('footer')->setThirdPartySetting('domain_menu_access','access_enabled',TRUE)->save()).

evals.prompt: On this site, per-domain menu control (domain_menu_access) has been switched on for exactly one menu. Inspect the live configuration and name the menu that currently has domain menu access enabled.
evals.expected_output: The 'account' menu has access_enabled true in system.menu.account (Menu::load('account')->getThirdPartySetting('domain_menu_access','access_enabled')).

evals.prompt: Using domain_menu_access, enable per-domain access control on the 'Administration' menu (machine name admin) on this site, so its links can be scoped per domain. Apply it to the live site.
